subject: DPA signoff: staggered rollout + DocuSign path
messages:
From: Samuel Price <samuel.price@databridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Shaw <emily.shaw@databridge.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: DPA & transfer addendum — closeout timeline

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We had one follow-up from Legal: they need a short execution plan showing how Redwood intends to stagger the rollout (initial EU-only pilot, followed by global expansion) and confirmation of which order form will be in scope for the transfer addendum. DataBridge's procurement team flagged that they need the DPA redline and the signing route (DocuSign vs countersign) by end of week to avoid delaying the go-live.

I've attached the DPA template they expect us to review and a consolidated list of technical evidence items they requested (SCC mapping, KMS overview, export controls summary). Can you confirm: 1) who on your side will lead the DPA redline; 2) whether we can accept a phased scope (pilot first) in the transfer addendum; and 3) whether CFO/legal clearance is required before DocuSign?

Suggested recipients on your side: Ben Carter (sales procurement), Laura Bennett (GC) and whoever on infra can confirm KMS details.

Best,
Samuel
--
Samuel Price
Head of Partnerships
DataBridge Inc.
Attachments: DataBridge_DPA_template.docx (docx), requested_evidence_list.xlsx (xlsx)

Subject: Re: DPA & transfer addendum — closeout timeline

Samuel — thanks, received.

Quick answers up front: 1) I'll lead the DPA redline (legal ops triage); 2) a phased scope is acceptable in principle — we typically put pilot systems in the transfer addendum and roll global scope via an Order Form amendment; 3) GC clearance is required before we send DocuSign, but Laura can give provisional signoff pending a one-hour technical attestation from infra.

Action plan I propose:
- I will produce a first redline and run it by Ben for commercial carve-outs by EOD Thursday.
- Aditya, can you confirm KMS regioning and whether we can provide a short attestation doc? (see items from their evidence list).
- Laura, if you approve the commercial carve-outs, we'll route the DPA to DocuSign and include the phased scope language.

I will attach our redline in this thread when ready.

Irene

Samuel — attaching our first redline and a short execution note. High-level summary of changes from Redwood:
- Scoped transfer addendum to named Order Form (OrderForm_v3) and explicitly allowed staged scope (pilot scope listed in Exhibit A).
- Narrowed processor roles language where we could (clarified “on behalf of” obligations for contract monitoring).
- Kept SCCs mapping standard but added an evidence deliverable timeline (KMS attestation + export-controls note within five business days of DPA signature).
- Proposed controlled fallback: if pilot requires cross-border testing we will use pseudonymized datasets only, unless parties agree otherwise in writing.

We deliberately left indemnity and liability language unchanged — Laura, happy to discuss if DataBridge pushes.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_redline_20261123.docx, Redwood_execution_note_20261123.pdf

Irene

Irene / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the redline. DataBridge Legal reviewed the redline this morning and returned a few narrow asks:
1) They want Exhibit A (pilot systems list) tightened to specific endpoints rather than service categories — they will send a short amendment template.
2) A single sentence confirmation from Laura as GC that liability and indemnity remain in line with the previously-negotiated MSA (they prefer not to re-open the clause).

Thanks — Samuel
